description: This file is a shell script designed to test git diff text conversion caching mechanisms. It sets up a testing environment involving git commits, attributes, and custom text conversion filters, and validates that caching behaves correctly under various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates object IDs based on hash algorithms.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Sets up object ID cache for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
